armaments.name: Buckler
armaments.blurb: Small enough to be quick with.

armaments.blurb: You will not be moved. You will not move.

armaments.name: Round Shield
armaments.blurb: Plain, round, and enough.

armaments.name: Spiked Shield
armaments.blurb: Defence with an opinion.

armaments.name: Dusk Chime
